wikipedia.extract: Thamnistes is a genus of antbirds in the family Thamnophilidae. It is primarily found in lowland and foothill forests from Central America to the northern and eastern Andes.
wikipedia.title: Thamnistes

commonNames.name: Ankarana Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Ankarana sportive lemur (Lepilemur ankaranensis), or Ankarana weasel lemur, is a sportive lemur endemic to Madagascar. It is one of the smaller sportive lemurs with a total length of about 53 cm (21 in), including 25 cm (9.8 in) of tail.
wikipedia.title: Ankarana sportive lemur

wikipedia.extract: The blue duck (Hymenolaimus malacorhynchos) or whio is a member of the duck, goose and swan family, Anatidae and is endemic to New Zealand. It is the only individual species belonging to the genus Hymenolaimus.
wikipedia.title: Blue duck

commonNames.name: Kinda Baboon
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Kinda baboon (Papio kindae) is a species of baboon present in the miombo woodlands of Angola, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Zambia, and possibly western Tanzania. It was once considered a subspecies of the yellow baboon (P. cynocephalus), then distinct enough to merit status as full species (P. kindae) under the phylogenetic species concept.
wikipedia.title: Kinda baboon

wikipedia.extract: Monasa is a genus of puffbirds in the Bucconidae family. The genus was described by the French ornithologist Louis Pierre Vieillot in 1816 with the black nunbird (Monasa atra) as the type species.
wikipedia.title: Monasa

wikipedia.extract: The Antarctic petrel (Thalassoica antarctica) is a boldly marked dark brown and white petrel, found in Antarctica, most commonly in the Ross and Weddell Seas. They eat Antarctic krill, fish, and small squid.
wikipedia.title: Antarctic petrel

wikipedia.extract: Strepsirrhini or Strepsirhini ( ; STREP-sə-RY-nee) is a suborder of primates that includes the lemuriform primates, which consist of the lemurs of Madagascar, galagos ("bushbabies") and pottos from Africa, and the lorises from India and Southeast Asia. Collectively they are referred to as strepsirrhines.
wikipedia.title: Strepsirrhini

wikipedia.extract: Scelorchilus is a genus of bird in the family Rhinocryptidae.
wikipedia.title: Scelorchilus

wikipedia.extract: The central chimpanzee or the tschego (Pan troglodytes troglodytes) is a subspecies of chimpanzee. It can be found in Central Africa, mostly in Gabon, Cameroon, the Republic of the Congo and the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
wikipedia.title: Central chimpanzee

commonNames.name: L'Hoest's Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: L'Hoest's monkey (Allochrocebus lhoesti), also known as the mountain monkey, is a guenon found in the upper eastern Congo Basin. They mostly live in mountainous forest areas in small, female-dominated groups.
wikipedia.title: L'Hoest's monkey

wikipedia.extract: Grallaria is a large genus of Neotropical birds in the antpitta family Grallariidae.
wikipedia.title: Grallaria

wikipedia.extract: Presbyornis is an extinct genus of presbyornithid bird from North America during the Paleogene period, between the Late Paleocene and Early Eocene.
wikipedia.title: Presbyornis

wikipedia.extract: Plioperdix is an extinct genus of phasianid that lived during the Neogene period.
wikipedia.title: Plioperdix

wikipedia.extract: Dryopithecus is a genus of extinct great apes from the middle–late Miocene boundary of Europe 12.5 to 11.1 million years ago (mya). Since its discovery in 1856, the genus has been subject to taxonomic turmoil, with numerous new species being described from single remains based on minute differences amongst each other, and the fragmentary nature of the holotype specimen makes differentiating remains difficult.
wikipedia.title: Dryopithecus

commonNames.name: Eastern Pygmy Marmoset
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The eastern pygmy marmoset (Cebuella niveiventris) is a marmoset species, a very small New World monkey, found in the southwestern Amazon rainforest in Bolivia, Brazil, Ecuador, and Peru. It was formerly regarded as conspecific with the similar western pygmy marmoset, but the eastern pygmy marmoset has whitish colored underparts.
wikipedia.title: Eastern pygmy marmoset

commonNames.name: Ankarana Dwarf Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Cheirogaleus shethi Frasier, Lei, McLain, Taylor, Bailey et al., 2016

wikipedia.extract: The Ankarana dwarf lemur or Sheth's dwarf lemur (Cheirogaleus shethi) is a species of dwarf lemur, part of the C. medius group, known only from northern Madagascar. It has been found in two reserves (Ankarana Special Reserve and Analamerana Special Reserve) as well as two protected areas (Andrafiamena-Andavakoera and Loky-Manambato).
wikipedia.title: Ankarana dwarf lemur

wikipedia.extract: Arenicolumba prattae is an extinct species of small pigeon from the Miocene of Florida. It was described from fossil material (a left coracoid) collected at the Thomas Farm Site in Gilchrist County, northern Florida, south-eastern United States.
wikipedia.title: Arenicolumba
